extras.real_size: revolving door module, drum 2.0 m diameter, 2.0 x 2.0 x 3.0 m
extras.notes: replaces one 2 m wall module: the drum is centred on the wall line (origin bottom centre = wall origin), neighbouring walls end at x = -1 / +1; floor disc top 0.105 like the kit thresholds; curved glass side walls with brass frames, white canopy drum with a brass band up to the 3.0 m wall height (flat top); four glass wings with push bars on a centre post form the movable part 'revolving-door_wings' (origin on the vertical axis, rotate about Z); no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
